meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，你的NanoClaw可以通过腾讯官方API连接个人微信号。扫码登录后，它能接收微信消息并自动回复，也能主动给微信用户发消息。
howto.when: 当你启用微信频道（设置WECHAT_ENABLED=true）并启动服务后，需要手机扫码登录。随后，任何微信用户向机器人账号发送消息时触发。

say.text: 帮我连接微信好友张三的聊天
say.note: 运行wire-dm脚本将张三的会话接入智能体

say.text: 设置微信陌生人权限为需要审批
say.note: 新用户发消息时会生成审批卡片给管理员
检查扫码是否成功、是否在线

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, your NanoClaw can connect to your personal WeChat account via Tencent's official API. After scanning a QR code, it can receive and reply to WeChat messages automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you enable the channel (set WECHAT_ENABLED=true), start the service, and scan the QR code. Then any WeChat message sent to the bot account will be processed.

say_en.text: Help me connect WeChat friend Zhang San's chat
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm script to wire that conversation to the agent

say_en.text: Set stranger permission to require approval
say_en.note: New messages from strangers trigger an approval card for admin
Verify scan success and online status
